text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With another year under her belt, Narita Brian will be entering races as a senior this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm reviewing last year's training and planning her new schedule…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swish…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like something came in through the window. I look in the direction of the sound, and…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I figured you were here since one of the windows was open… Guess I was right on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tossing that letter in was the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was sitting under the kotatsu at my parents' place when your face came to mind…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So I decided to drop by on my way home from the gym. Then I saw your window open. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Come on, we don't have time for this. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …It's starting!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We're here at the New Year's special exhibition race! Coming around the fourth corner, all sixteen racers are grouped together!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Who will take the first prize of the New Year? It looks like someone is steadily breaking away from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Go! Pass 'em! Keep going! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What? You don't like it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Check out the leader! That's pretty good form. If she keeps this up… she's gonna take it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha, just like I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I went to the gym and watched a race. That's all I had planned for today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If I don't go home soon, my mom's going to start nagging about how I should be using my New Year's break to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Still, it's fortunate you happened to be around so we could watch the race together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I know classes and training will start in a few days and we'll see each other a lot, but…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: For some reason, I wanted to see you sooner this year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …All right.
choice_data_list: Today was a nice change of pace.
Hope you're looking forward to the year's first training session!
I'll work hard to meet your expectations.
I'll work hard to meet your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …All right.
choice_data_list: Today was a nice change of pace.
Hope you're looking forward to the year's first training session!
I'll work hard to meet your expectations.
I'll work hard to meet your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. Anyway, see ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian heads toward the station with a slight spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, I definitely am. Can't go wrong with your training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should run home to keep myself sharp. It's only about—
choice_data_list: That's probably not a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm. You think so?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian reluctantly promises to wait until after the New Year holiday to start her training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …You don't have to be so serious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But, I am expecting great things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're expecting the same of me after all, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, we end up watching one more race together before going home.
